subject.title: fix(qa): reject runtime tool intent without result evidence

question: Should the runtime-tool release-validation lane deliberately require only `session-status`, `web-fetch`, and `web-search` until the other nine report-only rows gain linked successful result evidence?
rationale: This is a release-validation policy choice, not a mechanical correctness question: the patch correctly distinguishes evidence quality, but it also reduces the mandatory coverage set.

options.title: Accept the evidence-based minimum
options.body: Approve the three retained result-backed rows as the current required readiness contract and keep the other rows as honest skips or report-only diagnostics.

options.title: Keep a broader required gate
options.body: Require additional tools to obtain canonical linked successful-result scenarios before their required flags can be removed.

recommendation.title: Accept the evidence-based minimum
recommendation.body: Approve the three retained result-backed rows as the current required readiness contract and keep the other rows as honest skips or report-only diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged persisted-results follow-up is the direct foundation for the evidence contract that this PR extends.
